newsitem.title: FRANCE: Air Liberte 1995/96 loss seen at 600 mln Ffr-paper.
newsitem.headline: Air Liberte 1995/96 loss seen at 600 mln Ffr-paper.

text.p: French airline Air Liberte is expected to report a loss of around 600 million francs for the 12 months to the end of October, the Figaro newspaper said on Saturday.
Air Liberte lost 160 million francs in the first half.

Air Liberte chairman Lofti Belhassine told the Journal du Dimanche that the carrier's troubles were not due to its rapid route expansion but to a price war and preferential treatment given to state-owned Air France by the Paris airport authorities.
An advance copy of the interview was sent to Reuters.
"The public authorities need to redefine fair rules of the game," Belhassine was quoted as saying.
He said the company was losing money this year but did not say how much.
The Figaro said on Saturday Air Liberte's board will meet on Thursday to study Belhassine's recovery plan for the carrier.
Air Liberte in June signed an accord with Air Outre Mer (AOM) involving cooperation on some routes.
